dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABIDE-I (NYU, USM sites); ABIDE-II (GU, OHSU sites); GSP (referred as BGS); COBRE; Utrecht; Cam-CAN (referred as CAMCAN); IXI; OASIS (assumed OASIS-1); NKI (referred as ROCKLAND); and other datasets not in the list: AOMIC (ID1000, PIOP1, PIOP2), DLBS, NARRATIVES, SALD, and clinical ASD datasets (MITASD, WASHASD, MADRID-ASD).

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: For each of the 20 datasets, healthy controls (HC) were split 90/10 into training and HCtest sets. All cases from clinical datasets (ABIDE, MITASD, WASHASD, MADRID-ASD, COBRE, UTRECHT) were included in the test set.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: For each of the datasets exclusively comprising healthy controls 90% of individuals went into the training set and 10% into the test set (HCtest)... From each of the clinical datasets, i.e. those datasets including cases and healthy controls, 90% of the healthy controls were added to the training set and 10% were added to the HCtest. All cases with ASD or SZ were added to the test set.

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Overall HC (n=5430) is the sum of training HC (n=4904) and test HC (n=526). One primary normative model was used, with several replication analyses (A1, A2, A3) exploring different parcellations or subgroups.

The training set consisted of 4904 healthy individuals (54.85% female, age range: 6-95 years)... z-scores to quantify individual deviations from the normative mean in a test set consisting of healthy controls (HC test, n=526, 40% male).

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The age range for the training set is explicitly stated as 6-95 years. Mean and SD for the entire sample are not reported in the main text or supplemental tables provided. The range for overall HC is inferred to be the same as the training set as it encompasses the case range (7-65).
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: The training set consisted of 4904 healthy individuals (... age range: 6-95 years). The age range encompassed the age range of the cases (range: 7-65 years).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Overall HC (n=5430) has 44.68% male (2426 male, 3004 female). Training set (n=4904) has 45.15% male (2214 male, 2690 female). Test HC numbers are derived by subtraction (526 total, 212 male, 314 female).
